info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Discount Pricing Management API
info.description: The Discount Pricing Management API facilitates the adjustment of discount structures for banking products. This API allows authorized users to modify existing discount pricing configurations to enhance competitive offerings. It caters primarily to financial institutions and product managers who aim to optimize their pricing strategies. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure their product pricing aligns with market demands and consumer behavior, ultimately driving increased sales and customer satisfaction.

patch.summary: Update discount pricing for a specific product.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to modify the discount pricing associated with a specific product identified by RES-100045. You can adjust various pricing parameters to reflect current promotions or pricing strategies.

requestBody.description: Updates the discount pricing details for a specific product identified by RES-100045. This operation requires a JSON payload that specifies the new values for various discount pricing properties.
